scope: Historical URL-only source-label benchmark; not a deployed classifier or a final hybrid evaluation.
selection: mean validation F1 across the five recorded development splits
interpretation_limits: Freeze records the completed development protocol and evidence, not a Git tag, main merge, or production release.
The old Assignment 02 test was already evaluated. Phase 1 did not evaluate it again; it is not a fresh final holdout.
Five overlapping development splits do not provide independent confidence intervals or prove RF superiority.
25/50/75/100 percent diagnostics vary the existing training pool, not a newly expanded external URL corpus. Subsets were not nested.
Source, period, and HTTPS bias remain; no claim of current real-world performance.
Paired URL/DOM work requires a separately versioned dataset and a new unused domain-grouped holdout.
change_policy: Do not retune or overwrite this historical baseline. Fixes require a new explicitly versioned experiment; DOM changes are separate modules.
